name: dotv-canvas
description: Drive the DOTV infinite canvas from your agent: read and edit nodes, run image/video/audio generations, and report what changed on the canvas.

interface.longDescription: DOTV is an AI video creation canvas: one infinite board where a story turns into a script, a storyboard, images, video, voice and a finished cut. This connector exposes that canvas to your agent over MCP, so it can inspect nodes, wire a flow, run generations and hand you a canvas to look at.
defaultPrompt: Open my latest DOTV canvas and tell me what is on it
Turn this script into a storyboard on my DOTV canvas
Add an image node to the open DOTV canvas and generate it
